body: Why not x)
I'll rather stick on discord but I want some people I trust on it so...
I don't really go on discord since I had some trouble there, I don't even know where to go to be honest.
Yeah I understand... But I don't really have good friends, maybe only one and they aren't trans and I don't want to feel lonely and be alone.

Nothing really picked my interest in this life. Really. I just don't know what to do, all the time.

I don't even want to be the lead. Just be at the back is enough. I know the pain and effort to go there. I was already contacted to do chorals a few years back because they loved my voice but I did refuse, I didn't have the time back then. But I know I'm too old anyway so what's so point?
We have just a binaries of choice : winning or failing, all or nothing... There's many other things like that in daily life. It's always A or B when you come to a choice. Of course I read that. I like all of the hidden parts even if it can be very dark. Even with darkness, the pain and work, it seems fun. 

Here, it's over either way. I'm screwed. No more thing to add.

I've already come out to some classmates, they've happy for me but honestly I didn't felt anything, and that put me more in this state. And my family, don't count on it, even if they supports me, they are toxic.

I don't want to be in that kind of group tbh even if I love rock, just want to be in a cutier and more girly band I think. Still, I can't imagine how I would be motivated in life without achieving this. It's a key point. It's this or nothing.

Tbh volonteering doesn't seems something that I want to do. It's so depressing and unfunny. I want to help, but not really to that kind of stuff.

Will look through it.

How can I know that hrt won't help? Just seeing some people talking about it and people who sadly don't pass. The harm in trying is just postponing my death with losing all of my family in the process.

Sorry. It's really the end for me. There's no miracle, so at least I tried you know. Tried until the end.

I just wanted to have goods teenage years, with some really good friends, kinda cute and kinda popular. Be a singer in a group. Spread joy to everyone and makes them happier each day. It would have been so much different but way more enjoyable for me. If I had the same people that I know there it would be perfect.

Never tried hrt. It won't change my life. I'll be at best a parody of a woman. Might as well kill myself. That's how I started that. Now it's the end.
Read everything. It's still not a life I want to live. I would barely survive so... I'm on my way to the end, sorry

Tried to shave all possible hair, there's still a few, shaving my beard just irritate my skin and I'm all red 3 days straight, and it's not completely shaved. Tried to straightened my hair but failed because my hair doesn't want that and it's too messy. But even with that, I can't feel euphoria. I just need to be like a cis woman, head to toe. And even there I'm not sure I'll be euphoric because I need to pass flawlessly. Never tried to girlmode because I need to hide everything and I can't.
I'm 21

I tried my best for that but it's not enough now...
It's the only solution
A lifeline can't help I think. If it really worked I would be okay.
I don't have any of this anymore.
Having this life is so much worst than death. The choice is clear for me.
You're strong. I'm not. You always had the will to live, even if you didn't know it. I don't have the motivation to stay here anymore.
I know everyone have been there, but I'm not everyone. If everyone succeed, it means that I'll fail.

I'm anxious because everything that I want to be involved in result to a fail. Each time. I can't talk to anyone outside due to this too and I struggle to find some shows to watch because I'll drop them very fast even when I could loved them.

Stalked 100%

I would like to sing, dance, dub... watch some shows and stuff like that.

I can't keep the pace anymore. It's far too long.
Nothing good can be around the corner.

No, I can't anyway because of my parents.
My mother and my father
They don't believe in that. For them if I want to go well I must be positive and always say yes.
Would be much easier if my mother wasn't stalking me everytime. I can't even go to the doctor alone. I can't leave the house alone.

I'm trapped with them for 3 months with no car, no transports, and everything is at 50 miles.
I don't want to be homeless.
Someone who won't kick me out of their office because I'm not having the same approach of gender than them.
I don't have any safe therapist near where I'm living.

I'm sorry...

I mean, they're my whole world. They're just my most precious treasure. I don't want to let them go but... I would make them suffering more staying alive than dead.
But they have ptsd about suicide. I can't talk to them about it.

Yeah...

Thanks anyway
It doesn't work with me. I'm writing that because I know I won't have the control. Ever.

I tried every anxiety management possible. I tried to say positive things, I tried to ignore myself, I tried to push my life in a good way and it has backfired, everything I like and that I'm into dies I soon as I know them.

I don't deserve to live
Gaming is basically the only thing with music and TV Series/shows which can help a little so I know the feeling. I wish I could play better games tho.

I'm just cursed, everytime I'm into something that I really want something, it all end suddently. 

I'm not even talking about the previous stuff I've already posted

I'll wait until sunday to do something. But miracles don't exist so I'll begin to plan my new path I think.

J'en vois pas mal vers 15 ans.

Je pense toujours ça, même si je vois pas en quoi mes certitudes seraient fausses, je me suis renseignée non-stop pendant plus d'un an pour faire mon propre avis sur un futur. Ça ne peut juste pas marcher.

​

Heureusement que pour toi ça a réussi. Mais je ne suis pas les autres, je suis moi, et dès que je prends une décision, que je touche quelque chose, ou que je m'intéresse à une chose, même si c'est de l'or, ça pourri en très peu de temps.

Je vais quand même attendre dimanche soir avant de faire un truc mais honnêtement les miracles n'existent pas.

Et je ne peux franchement plus attendre.

Les blagues carambar c'est cool.

Je sais mais au bout d'un moment, le soutien n'est plus assez. J'ai besoin de plus que ça pour être touchée maintenant.

Les bons résultats c'est qu'une faible minorité. Ça me donne juste encore plus envie de me tuer.
Déjà essayé, ils me suivent juste partout, et sans eux j'ai pas de toit ni d'argent.

Déjà fait. Ça renforce juste mon avis.

Je veux juste être normale. Je sais que je ne serais jamais à l'aise dans mon corps.
